title: Signal
description: A normalised buying signal with provenance and prioritisation metadata.

signalId.description: Unique identifier for this signal, e.g. 'SIG-2026-001'.

accountName.description: Name of the target account this signal relates to.

contactName.description: Optional: name of the individual involved, if known and sourced.

description.description: Plain-language description of the signal event.

source.description: URL or name of the source (e.g. 'LinkedIn Jobs', 'Company blog').

sourceDate.description: Date the signal event occurred or was published.

discoveredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this signal was discovered.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the signal's accuracy and relevance.

recommendedAction.description: Suggested next action. All external actions require human approval.

status.description: Current handling status of this signal.
